title.en: Health and common diseases in humans

hook.en: Bacteria, viruses, fungi, protozoans and worms all cause disease. Knowing how each one spreads is the first step to stopping it.
hook.kn: ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾ, ವೈರಸ್, ಶಿಲೀಂಧ್ರ, ಪ್ರೋಟೋಜೋವಾ ಮತ್ತು ಹುಳುಗಳು ರೋಗ ಉಂಟುಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ. ಅವು ಹೇಗೆ ಹರಡುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂದು ತಿಳಿಯುವುದು ತಡೆಗಟ್ಟುವಿಕೆಯ ಮೊದಲ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ.

body.en: *Health* is a state of complete physical, mental and social well-being. Disease-causing organisms are pathogens. Typhoid is caused by Salmonella typhi, which enters the small intestine through contaminated food and water; it is confirmed by the Widal test. Pneumonia is caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae and Haemophilus influenzae, which infect the alveoli of the lungs; the alveoli fill with fluid. The common cold is caused by rhinoviruses, which infect the nose and respiratory passage but not the lungs.
body.kn: ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಎಂದರೆ ದೈಹಿಕ, ಮಾನಸಿಕ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾಜಿಕ ಸ್ವಾಸ್ಥ್ಯ. ಟೈಫಾಯ್ಡ್‌ಗೆ ಸಾಲ್ಮೊನೆಲ್ಲಾ ಟೈಫಿ ಕಾರಣ, ವಿಡಾಲ್ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆಯಿಂದ ಖಚಿತ. ನ್ಯುಮೋನಿಯಾಗೆ ಸ್ಟ್ರೆಪ್ಟೋಕಾಕಸ್ ನ್ಯುಮೋನಿಯೇ ಮತ್ತು ಹೀಮೋಫಿಲಸ್ ಇನ್‌ಫ್ಲುಯೆಂಜೇ. ನೆಗಡಿಗೆ ರೈನೋವೈರಸ್‌ಗಳು.

points.en: Pneumonia: S. pneumoniae, H. influenzae; alveoli

title.en: Board: common diseases and their pathogens

say.en: Diseases caused by bacteria: typhoid, by Salmonella typhi, confirmed by the Widal test; pneumonia, by Streptococcus pneumoniae, in which the alveoli fill with fluid.
A virus: rhinoviruses cause the common cold in the nose and respiratory passage, but not the lungs.
Protozoa: Plasmodium causes malaria, spread by the female Anopheles mosquito; Entamoeba histolytica causes amoebiasis, spread by houseflies.
Worms: Ascaris spreads through contaminated water and vegetables; Wuchereria causes filariasis, with swollen lymphatic vessels.
The malaria cycle: sporozoites enter with a mosquito bite, multiply in liver cells and then in red blood cells. Bursting RBCs release haemozoin, causing chills and fever every 3 to 4 days.

body.en: Malaria is caused by Plasmodium (P. vivax, P. malariae, P. falciparum; falciparum malaria is the most serious and can be fatal). Sporozoites, the infective stage, enter through the bite of an infected female Anopheles mosquito; the parasites multiply in liver cells and then in red blood cells, whose rupture releases haemozoin, causing chills and high fever recurring every three to four days. Amoebiasis (Entamoeba histolytica) spreads through houseflies that carry cysts to food. Ascariasis (Ascaris) spreads through contaminated water and vegetables. Filariasis or elephantiasis (Wuchereria bancrofti and W. malayi) is spread by mosquito bites. Ringworm is caused by fungi of the genera Microsporum, Trichophyton and Epidermophyton. Aedes mosquitoes spread dengue and chikungunya; the fish Gambusia feeds on mosquito larvae.
body.kn: ಮಲೇರಿಯಾಗೆ ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಮೋಡಿಯಮ್ ಕಾರಣ; ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಅನಾಫಿಲಿಸ್ ಸೊಳ್ಳೆ ಹರಡುತ್ತದೆ. ಹೀಮೋಜೋಯಿನ್ ಚಳಿ ಜ್ವರಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣ. ಅಮೀಬಿಯಾಸಿಸ್, ಆಸ್ಕರಿಯಾಸಿಸ್, ಆನೆಕಾಲು ರೋಗ ಮತ್ತು ಹುಳುಕಡ್ಡಿ ಇತರ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ರೋಗಗಳು.

say.en: An infected female Anopheles bites a human and injects sporozoites (the infective stage). Sporozoites reach the liver, multiply asexually inside liver cells, and the cells burst.

Personal hygiene, clean drinking water, proper disposal of waste and excreta, and controlling vectors. Removing standing water (coolers, old tyres, pots) stops Aedes breeding, which carries dengue and chikungunya.

narration.en: Recap. Typhoid: Salmonella typhi, confirmed by the Widal test. Pneumonia infects alveoli; common cold is caused by rhinoviruses. Malaria: Plasmodium via female Anopheles; haemozoin causes fever. Prevent vector-borne disease by removing stagnant water.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಟೈಫಾಯ್ಡ್: ಸಾಲ್ಮೊನೆಲ್ಲಾ ಟೈಫಿ, ವಿಡಾಲ್ ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ. ನ್ಯುಮೋನಿಯಾ ಅಲ್ವಿಯೋಲೈಗಳಿಗೆ; ನೆಗಡಿ ರೈನೋವೈರಸ್‌ನಿಂದ. ಮಲೇರಿಯಾ: ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಮೋಡಿಯಮ್, ಹೆಣ್ಣು ಅನಾಫಿಲಿಸ್; ಹೀಮೋಜೋಯಿನ್ ಜ್ವರಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣ. ನಿಂತ ನೀರು ತೆಗೆದು ವಾಹಕ ರೋಗಗಳನ್ನು ತಡೆಯಿರಿ.
